title: EAF-TTS: Rethinking Codec-Latent Coordinates for Flow TTS
abstract: arXiv:2611.27214v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent text-to-speech (TTS) systems generate codec latents decoded by a frozen decoder, but good reconstruction does not ensure geometry suitable for Flow generation from isotropic Gaussian noise. We present Embedded Acoustic Flow TTS (EAF-TTS), an acoustic-latent adaptation of ELF with phone- and duration-conditioned generation, shared-network terminal correction, and frozen WaveVAE decoding. EAF-TTS supports a fixed ZCA interface estimated from training data and adding no learned parameters. The codec, conditioning modules, Flow backbone, and 20-call inference are shared. The intervention is the full ZCA coordinate protocol---training and sampling coordinates, induced loss metric, and terminal perturbation---not an inference-only transform. translated_title: EAF-TTS：重新思考面向流模型的编解码器潜在坐标
translated_abstract: 潜在文本到语音（TTS）系统生成由冻结解码器解码的编解码器潜在表示，但良好的重建效果并不能保证其几何结构适合从各向同性高斯噪声出发的流生成。我们提出了嵌入式声学流TTS（EAF-TTS），这是ELF在声学潜在表示上的适配版本，具备音素和时长条件生成、共享网络终端校正以及冻结的WaveVAE解码。EAF-TTS支持一个从训练数据估计得到的固定ZCA接口，不引入任何可学习参数。编解码器、条件模块、流骨干网络以及20次调用的推理过程均保持共享。其核心干预是完整的ZCA坐标协议——涵盖训练与采样坐标、诱导损失度量以及终端扰动——而并非仅在推理阶段应用的变换。在单说话人LJSpeech数据集上，64维训练潜在协方差的条件数为1355.44。在文本不相交的Val399严格-GT测试集上，使用三个匹配种子下的固定E100原始检查点，ZCA（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: EAF-TTS提出将完整的ZCA坐标协议（包括训练与采样坐标、诱导损失度量及终端扰动）应用于声学潜在空间，重新调整编解码器潜在坐标的几何结构，使其更适合从各向同性高斯噪声进行流式TTS生成。
en_tdlr: EAF-TTS rethinks codec-latent coordinates by applying a full ZCA coordinate protocol—covering training and sampling coordinates, the induced loss metric, and terminal perturbation—to reshape the latent geometry, making it suitable for flow-based TTS generation from isotropic Gaussian noise.
